verdict.rationale: Sentry's own Agents Dashboards show model costs and token usage. The LLM Calls view surfaces token usage and cost for individual model requests so models can be compared, and the traces table lists total tokens, total cost and timestamp per trace. The time-period part of the story is only implied by per-trace timestamps, and per-model breakdown is mostly implied by the Model Cost widget, so the story is not completely documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of cost/token aggregation over selectable time periods, an explicit per-model cost/token breakdown in a dashboard widget, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see cost and token usage per request, model, and time period in dashboards

citations.quote: **LLM Calls** shows individual model requests. Use it to compare models, prompts, token usage, cost, and response performance without reviewing an entire conversation or trace.
View agent executions, model costs, token usage, tool calls, and recent errors in the Agents Dashboards.
The Model Cost widget shows estimated costs based on token usage and model pricing.
Below these widgets is a traces table showing trace ID, agents, root duration, errors, LLM calls, tool calls, total tokens, total cost, and timestamp.
